This '''Research lab''' was located within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and was in use of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gubacher/Legends|Gubacher]]. It was used to keep operational droids in contact for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] for later uses at maximum condition during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], this lab was used by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gubacher/Legends|Gubacher]] to prepare [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]] for a infiltration [[Mission to steal a Separatist encryption module/Legends|mission]] onboard a [[Aut-O's flagship/Legends|Separatist Dreadnaught]] to retrieve an [[Encryption module/Legends|Encryption module]]. It also was used to remove [[M5-BZ/Legends|M5-BZ's]] [[Memory bank/Legends|memory banks]] to make room for the [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Coronel's]] command center to guide D-Squad through its mission.
